description: This file defines the enum 'GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport' containing static methods for handling gateway selection logic in a Swift-based application. It integrates with models, helpers, and configuration files to determine preferred transports, update states, and configure remote gateway URLs based on discovery data.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Updates the application's remote transport, URL, and target based on the discovered gateway, changing configuration as needed.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport method for a given gateway, defaulting to current if no direct preference is found.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Decides if direct transport should be preferred based on gateway properties, such as URL presence, ID prefix, and host suffix.
